verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Asana has AI Teammates and AI Studio automation features with access to work context (asana-docs-5, asana-docs-6, asana-docs-12) that could plausibly draft updates, and API tutorials exist for reading/reporting on status updates (asana-docs-4, asana-docs-9), but no direct evidence specifically shows AI generating/drafting a status update from recent project activity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or demo of AI auto-drafting a status update, first-party feature page describing this exact workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation it works as claimed.
